changes.rationale: Ship project hooks for Claude Code (.claude/settings.json) and Codex (.codex/hooks.json, .codex/rules/default.rules) on by default, replacing the opt-in Codex example's stop gate. scripts/agent-hook.sh guards edits and shell write destinations without Cargo: golden baselines and harness/config.json ask on Claude Code and are refused on Codex, other protected paths get a receipt note, a PR merge asks on Claude Code (refused on Codex) and a force-push is refused on both, and . and .. resolve before a path is tiered; any unexpected guard exit blocks; after an edit it runs cargo check --locked, cargo fmt --check and the built xtask's architecture check. scripts/agent-complete.sh now gates completion claims only. .claude/ and .codex/ join protected(), and Claude Code's per-machine settings.local.json and worktrees/ leave the source fingerprint. Hooks are speed bumps on the agent's machine: CI's check ci and handoff remain the enforcement, and only hosting rules stop a merge. The completion requirement lists the 16 new tests that gate it.
